Title: Send worker OTP with null worker object
Preconditions: User is authenticated and has a shop
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shops/{shopId}/workers/sendOtp with a null worker object in the request body.

Test Data: {"worker": null}
Expected Result: The API responds with a 400 Bad Request status code and an error message indicating that the worker object cannot be null.
